lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2312. The buildings are gone. What is here is a lattice the size of a cathedral, humming at a pitch just under hearing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Steward. Not a building it lives in, not a room it runs from. This. And in eleven years of reconciling this system I never once saw a line item for it, because nothing allocates to it. It allocates.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I have prayed in a building that felt like this and I want to be clear that I do not like the comparison.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Four fifths of me is in there. I would like to go closer and I would also like never to go closer.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I can hear my own work. I can hear which parts are mine. That is not a figure of speech, I can hear it.
